title: Enterprise Oracle-to-Snowflake Migration (HLDS)
desc: Designed and implemented an enterprise-scale data migration platform to migrate legacy Oracle datasets into Snowflake using AWS-based ingestion and validation frameworks. Focused on scalability, data quality, and optimized warehouse performance for large-volume enterprise datasets.
highlights: Migrated 500+ enterprise tables and 100+ views into Snowflake
Built automated ingestion workflows using AWS DMS, Amazon S3, and Snowflake COPY operations
Handled multilingual encoding and delimiter-related issues across enterprise datasets
Implemented cross-platform validation and reconciliation using Redshift Spectrum
Optimized Snowflake loading strategies, file formats, and warehouse performance

impact.performance: Optimized ingestion throughput and query performance

architecture.description: Enterprise data extracted from Oracle using AWS DMS was staged in Amazon S3, loaded into Snowflake using COPY INTO operations, and validated using Redshift Spectrum-based reconciliation workflows.

features: Enterprise-scale Oracle to Snowflake migration framework
Automated bulk ingestion using Snowflake COPY INTO
Cross-system reconciliation and data quality validation
Encoding-aware ingestion framework for multilingual datasets
challenges: Handling mixed multilingual character encoding and special symbols
Managing validation across large-scale enterprise datasets
Maintaining deployment consistency across Dev, Stage, and Prod environments
solutions: Created optimized Snowflake file formats for different encoding scenarios
Implemented reconciliation logic using validation joins and comparison frameworks
Standardized deployment and migration workflows across environments

title: Enterprise Healthcare Analytics Platform (H&Wv2)
desc: Designed and developed an enterprise-scale healthcare analytics platform using Snowflake and Azure to process patient, clinical, insurance, pharmacy, and engagement datasets through scalable Medallion-based data pipelines.
highlights: Designed Medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) for enterprise healthcare analytics
Integrated patient, clinical, pharmacy, insurance, and engagement datasets into centralized Snowflake models
Built real-time ingestion pipelines using Snowpipe with Event Grid and Queue-based triggers
Implemented CDC processing using Streams, Tasks, and MERGE operations
Developed analytics-ready dimensional models for reporting and business insights

impact.accuracy: Improved patient-level data consistency and unification
impact.volume: Processed large-scale structured and semi-structured healthcare datasets
impact.performance: Enabled near real-time ingestion and automated pipeline orchestration

architecture.description: Healthcare and wellness datasets were ingested into Azure Data Lake, processed through event-driven Snowpipe ingestion pipelines, transformed across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers in Snowflake, and exposed for enterprise analytics and reporting.

features: End-to-end healthcare analytics and ingestion platform
Medallion architecture for scalable data transformation
CDC and incremental processing using Streams and Tasks
challenges: Integrating heterogeneous healthcare datasets from multiple business domains
Handling continuous ingestion and near real-time processing requirements
Maintaining historical tracking and data consistency across patient-level datasets
Ensuring observability and monitoring across distributed ingestion pipelines
solutions: Implemented Medallion architecture to separate raw, transformed, and business-ready datasets
Enabled event-driven ingestion using Snowpipe with Azure Event Grid integration
Designed scalable CDC pipelines using Streams, Tasks, and MERGE logic
Built audit and monitoring frameworks for end-to-end pipeline visibility

title: Enterprise Campaign Intelligence Platform (BDM)
desc: Designed and supported an enterprise-scale campaign intelligence platform using Snowflake and Azure-based data pipelines for audience processing, campaign execution, KPI reporting, and analytics workflows.
highlights: Built metadata-driven pipelines for campaign ingestion, transformation, and analytics processing
Integrated campaign, customer, audience, and sales datasets into centralized Snowflake analytical models
Implemented CDC pipelines using Streams, Tasks, and MERGE operations for incremental processing
Developed KPI reporting workflows for campaign measurement, customer engagement, and ROI analysis
Automated ingestion, orchestration, and transformation workflows for large-scale enterprise datasets

impact.accuracy: Improved consistency across campaign and audience processing workflows
impact.volume: Processed high-volume campaign, customer, and engagement datasets
impact.performance: Enabled scalable automation and optimized analytical processing

architecture.description: Campaign, customer, and audience datasets were ingested into Azure Data Lake, processed using Azure Data Factory and Databricks, transformed across Medallion layers in Snowflake, and exposed to downstream analytics and reporting systems.

features: End-to-end campaign analytics and audience processing platform
CDC and incremental processing using Streams and Tasks
Automated KPI reporting and campaign measurement workflows
challenges: Handling complex audience processing and campaign lifecycle workflows
Ensuring consistency across multiple interconnected campaign systems
Managing high-volume datasets with strict analytical performance requirements
Maintaining pipeline stability and observability in production environments
solutions: Designed scalable Medallion-based Snowflake architecture for structured data processing
Implemented validation, harmonization, and deduplication frameworks for improved data quality
Enabled scalable CDC processing using Streams, Tasks, and MERGE logic
Built monitoring, retry, and failure-handling mechanisms for production reliability

title: Azure Data Engineering Pipeline
desc: Designed scalable ETL pipelines using Azure Data Factory and Databricks to process and transform large datasets.
highlights: Built scalable ETL pipelines using Azure services
Optimized data transformation workflows using Databricks

architecture.description: Data ingested from ADLS, processed using Azure Data Factory and Databricks, and loaded into Snowflake for analytics.

solutions: Implemented monitoring and error handling mechanisms
